name: Railgun
summary: The sources diverge on the Railgun: GamePressure says it is unlocked after the mission Minor Turbulence and bought at a gun store in single player, but Grand Theft Wiki's single-player weapon list does not include it. It is also a GTA Online weapon.

attrs.conflict: GamePressure: Story Mode after Minor Turbulence; Grand Theft Wiki single-player list: absent

sections.title: Divergence
sections.text: As fontes divergem / The sources disagree on whether the Railgun is a Story Mode weapon: GamePressure says it is unlocked after Minor Turbulence; Grand Theft Wiki's single-player list omits it; GTA5Wiki lists it (damage 100, magazine 1) but that site also lists Online weapons. It may depend on the game version, which is not confirmed. It is certainly a GTA Online weapon. Confidence that it is in Story Mode: about 50%.
